book.name: SOHN
book.title: Rongamwahu me Ntingdier sang rehn SOHN

content: Mehlahn Lasarus
Mie ohl emen me soumwahudahr me adaneki Lasarus, me koukousoan Pedani, nan kahnimw me Mery oh rie Marda koukousoan ie.
(Iei Mery menet me keiehki aluweluwen Kaun-o leh pwohmwahu oh limwiheki pitenmoange, iei ih me pil rianiki Lasarus me soumwahudahro.)
Pirieno eri kairehki Sises, “Maing at Kaun, kompoakepahmwio soumwahudahr.”

Ni Sises eh ketin karonge met, e ahpw mahsanih, “Soumwahu wet sohte pahn kahrehda Lasarus eh mehla; met wiawiher pwe en kalinganahda Koht, oh soumwahu wet pahn wia ehu ahl me Koht pahn ketin kalinganahkihda Sapwellimeo.”
Sises kin ketin loalloale Marda, oh rie lih, oh pil Lasarus.
Sises mwahngihier me Lasarus soumwahudahr, ahpw e ketikette wasa me e ketiket ieo erein rahn riau.
Eri, e ahpw mahsanihong sapwellime tohnpadahk ko, “Kitail pahn pwurala Sudia.”
Tohnpadahk ko ahpw sapeng, patohwan, “Maing Sounpadahk, rahn teiko mehn Suhs ako men katei komwi wasao. A ia duwe, komw pil kupwukupwure pwuralahng wasao?”
Sises ahpw sapeng, mahsanih, “Kaidehn awa eisek riau mie nan rahn ehu? Eri, ma mehmen me kin alialu nin rahn, e sohte pahn dipekelekel, pwehki eh kilikilang marain en sampahet.
A me kin alialu nipwong, e pahn dipekelekel, pwehki marain sohte mie reh.”
Sises ketin mahsanih mepwukat, ahpw pil pwurehng mahsanihong irail, “Kompoakepatail Lasarus meirlahr. A I pahn kolahng pangenda.”
Tohnpadahk ko ahpw sapeng, patohwan, “Maing, ma e meirlahr, a e pahn mwahula.”
Mahsen en Sises wet uhdahn wehwehki me Lasarus melahr, a irail ahpw kihkihong me e wehwehki me e memeirte.
Sises eri mahsanihong irail ni sansal, “Lasarus melahr.
A pwehki kumwail I perenkihda ei sohte mi reh, pwe kumwail en pwoson. Eri, kitail kohla reh.”
Tomas (me pil adaneki Mpwer) ahpw ndaiong ienge tohnpadahk ko, “Kitail iang atail Sounpadahk kohla wasao, pwe kitail en iang ih mehla.”
Sises me Iasada oh Mour
Ni Sises eh ketier wasao, e ahpw ketin diarada me Lasarus seridier oh rahn pahieu douwer powe.
Mwein sohte lel mwail riau me Pedani dohki sang Serusalem.
Mehn Suhs tohtohie me kodohng tuhwong Marda oh Mery pwe re en kamwait ira pwehki mehlahn riara ohlo.
Ni Marda eh rongada me Sises ketiket kohdo, e ahpw kohieila pwe en tuhwong; a Mery mihmihte nan ihmwo.
Marda ahpw patohwanohng Sises, “Maing ei Kaun, ma komw ketikette met, riei ohlo sohte pahn mehla.
Eri soh, I ese me Koht pahn ketikihong komwi dahme komw pahn ketin peki reh.”
Sises ahpw mahsanihong, “Riomw ohlo pahn pwurehng mourda.”
Marda ahpw sapeng, patohwan, “I patohwan ese me e pahn pwurehng mourda ni rahnen neko.”
Sises ahpw mahsanihong, “Ngehi me mour sapahl oh Sounkomour. Mehmen me pwoson ie, mehnda ma e pahn mehla, ahpw e pahn mour.
Oh mehmen me momour oh pwoson ie, sohte pahn mehla kohkohlahte. Ia duwe, ke kamehlele met?”
Liho ahpw sapeng, patohwan, “Ei, Maing ei Kaun, I kamehlele me komwi Mesaia, Sapwellimen Kohto, me pahn ketidohng sampah.”
Sises Tentenihr
Mwurin Marda eh patohwanehr mepwukat, e ahpw pwurala mwenginkihong rie Mery, “Sounpadahko ketidohr, oh e ketin keinemweiuk.”
Ni Mery eh rongada met, e ahpw mwadang uhda oh kohieila pwe en tuhwong Sises.
(Sises saikinte lelohng kousapwo, pwe e ketikette wasa me Marda tuhwong ieo.)
Mehn Suhs ako me iang Mery mihmi nan ihmwo, me kamwakamwait ih, re ahpw idawehn ahnsou me re kilang eh uhda oh mwadang pedoi. Irail kihkihong me e pahn kohieila nin sousowo pwe en mwahiei.
Ahpw ni Mery eh lellahng wasa me Sises ketiket ie, e ahpw poaridi mwohn aluweluwe kan oh patohwanohng, “Maing ei Kaun, ma komw ketikette met, riei ohlo sohte pahn mehla!”
Sises mahsanihada eh sengiseng, oh mehn Suhs ako me iang ih pil sengiseng, e ahpw kupwurohla oh pahtoula.
E ahpw ketin kalelapak rehrail, “Ia wasa me kumwail sarepediong ie?” Irail ahpw sapeng, patohwan, “Maing at Kaun, komw ketido oh mahsanih.”
Sises ahpw ketin tentenihr.
Mehn Suhs ako eri nda, “Ia uwen eh poakohng ohlo!”
Ahpw ekei nanpwungarail nda, “Kaidehn ih me kapehdpesengehr mesen ohl maskuno? Ia duwe, e sohte kak wia mehkot pwe en doarehsang Lasarus mehla?”
Lasarus Pwurehng Mourda
Sises eri pil pwurehng kupwurohla, ahpw ketilahng nin sousowo, me mi nan pwoaren paip ehu me takai ehu kin ritingala.”
Sises mahsanih, “Kumwail pwekasang takaien!” Marda, rien ohl me melahro, ahpw patohwanohng, “Maing, e pwohsuwedlahr, pwe rahn pahieu douwer pohn eh seridi!”
Sises ahpw mahsanihong liho, “I soh ndaionguhkehr me ke pahn kilang lingan en Koht ma ke pahn pwoson?”
Irail eri pwekasang takaio, Sises ahpw ketin sarada oh mahsanih, “Semei, kalahngan en komwi pwehki omwi ketin karongeier.
I ese me komwi kin ketin karonge ie ahnsou koaros, ahpw I patohwan mepwukat pwehki aramas pwukat me pato wasa kiset, re en kamehlele me komwi me ketin kadariehdo.”
Mwurin eh mahsaniher mepwukat, e ahpw kapitie laudida, mahsanih, “Lasarus, pedoido!”
Ohl melahro ahpw pedoido, peh oh neh kan kidikidkipene likoun nan sousou, oh likou ehu pidpene mese. Sises ahpw mahsanihong irail, “Kumwail sapwadada ohlen oh kasaladakala.”
Pwihn me Pelian Sises
Me tohto nanpwungen mehn Suhs ko me kohdo rehn Mery, re kilangehr dahme Sises ketin wiadahr, re ahpw pwosonlahr.
A ekei irail pwuralahng rehn Parisi ko oh padahkihong irail duwen mehkan me Sises ketin wiadahr.
Eri, samworo lapalap ako oh Parisi ko ahpw kapokonepene Tohn Mwoalen Kopwung Lapalapo, oh nda, “Dahme kitail pahn wia? Pwehki soangen kilel kan me ohl menet kin wiewia!
Ma kitail mweidohng en wiewia soahng pwukat, aramas koaros pahn pwosonla, oh lapalap akan en Rom pahn kohdo oh kauwehla atail Tehnpas Sarawio oh atail wehiet pwon!”
Emen kisehrail, me adaneki Kaiapas, me Samworo Lapalap nan pahro, ahpw ndaiong irail, “Kumwail sohte mwahn ese mehkot!
Kumwail sohte dehdehki me e pahn mwahuwong kumwail ma emen pahn mehkihla aramas akan, pwe tohn wehiet pwon en dehr mwomwla?”
(Ahpw mehlel, Kaiapas sohte wia koasoi pwoatet pwehki pein ih, ahpw pwehki ih me Samworo Lapalap en pahro, e ahpw kohpada me Sises pahn pwoukihla mehn Suhs ako;
oh kaidehn irailte, ahpw pwe en kapokonepene serien Koht kan koaruhsie me mweipesengehr.)
Eri, sang ni rahno kohla, kaunen mehn Suhs ako ahpw wiewie lamalamki duwen arail pahn kemehla.

Ihme kahrehda Sises solahr ketiketseli sansal nan Sudia. E ahpw ketsang wasao oh ketilahng wasa kis me kereniong sapwtehn, ni kahnimw me adaneki Epraim; eri, iei wasa me e ketidi ie, iangahki sapwellime tohnpadahk ko.
Eri, en mehn Suhs akan Sarawien Pahsohpa kerendohr, oh aramas tohtohie kohieila sang nan sahpw akan kohdalahng Serusalem, pwe re en kapwaiada arail tiahk en kamwakel mwohn sarawio eh pahn tepida.
Irail raparapahki Sises; oh ni arail pokonpenehr nan Tehnpas Sarawio, re kin peidekpene nanpwungarail, “Dahme kumwail lemeleme? Ohlo pahn iang sarawi wet, de soh?”
Samworo lapalap ako oh Parisi ko ahpw koasoanediong aramas akan, mehmen me ese wasa me Sises ketiket ie, a en pakairkihdo, pwe re en kak koledi.
